description_en: Updates the Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS) Container version of a High-Speed Service Framework (HSF) application. EDAS Container includes Ali-Tomcat and Pandora
description_zh: 调用UpdateContainer接口更新HSF应用的EDAS-Container版本。EDAS-Container包含Ali-Tomcat和Pandora
name: UpdateContainer

parameters.help_en: The build package number of EDAS Container. You can obtain the build package number in the Build package number column in the EDAS Container release notes table. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/92614.html
parameters.help_zh: EDAS-Container的构建包ID。可以在容器版本说明文档的表格中获取对应版本的构建包ID，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/92614.html
parameters.name: build_pack_id
